title: Isolated Tenancy Capacity Hypothesis Catalog and Q2 Activation Plan
creator: Anika Rao
description: Purpose: Create a consolidated, hypothesis-driven catalog of capacity lanes, customer cohorts, and activation experiments for isolated tenancy (Private/VPC/on‑prem) that feeds the quarterly roadmap and OKR cadence. This ticket scopes the Q2 plan: define hypotheses, success metrics, test harnesses, and cross-functional gating criteria for 3 activation lanes (Pilot, Cohort A, Cohort B).
objectives: Define 3 capacity lanes (pilot, production-small, production-large) with measurable hypotheses for onboarding time and SLA adherence
Produce a prioritized catalog of 12 activation hypotheses (compatibility vectors, network constraints, upgrade window behaviors, operator tooling gaps)
Establish telemetry and gating rules that map to OKR KR: reduce median tenant activation time to <72 hours and increase first‑week success rate to 95%
Align dependencies with Eng/Design/SRE owners and surface rollout guardrails in Console and Docs
milestones: 2026-02-10: Kickoff with Eng, SRE, Design, Solutions Eng
2026-02-20: Deliver first draft hypothesis catalog and acceptance criteria (this ticket)
2026-03-15: Run two pilot activations using Pilot lane harness
2026-04-05: Patrol and refine gating rules; update Console UX for activation state
2026-05-18: Cohort A roll (10 tenants) with SLA telemetry enabled
2026-06-30: Q2 retrofit: bake learnings into Q3 roadmap and finalize OKR scorecard
acceptance_criteria: Hypothesis catalog contains at least 12 discrete tests with owner and metric (time-to-activate, failure-mode count, rollback frequency)
Per-lane activation playbooks (pilot/psmall/plarge) published to Confluence with runbook and rollback steps
Console exposes activation phase and blocking reasons for customers (UI/UX mocks reviewed by Design)
Telemetry dashboard (Sandbox) collected for pilot activations showing median activation time, errors per step, config incompatibilities
Dependencies and gating checklist have assigned owners and estimated resolution time per blocker
dependencies: ENG-22567 (private-networking: vpc peering and routing certs)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Network topology differences across customer environments cause activation delays -> Mitigation: Add a preflight network probe in the activation harness
Risk: Upgrades while activating a tenant could induce functional regressions -> Mitigation: Add compatibility matrix and block upgrades during activation windows for Pilot lane
Risk: Insufficient observability in Console -> Mitigation: ship minimal activation-state API and use feature flag to iterate quickly
Risk: Security review delays for on‑prem connectors -> Mitigation: parallelize KMS/HSM review and provide temporary test keys for pilots
